name: maru
description: Make instruments, effects and sounds with Maru: the Maru agent skill, the hosted Maru connector for your account, the local Maru server for a module checkout, and skills to start a synth, find a community module to fork, check a plug-in build and list a plug-in on the Maru marketplace.

interface.longDescription:
Make playable instruments, effects and sound collections with Maru, and reach your Maru account from your agent.

Explore the official instruments: ask which synth fits a sound, read its parameters and open it on a factory preset with your changes. Remix the community: search published modules, read how they work and fork one into your account with its credit and licence kept. Start projects from Studio templates, follow your plug-in builds and see why one failed, and list a plug-in you built with any framework on the Maru marketplace.

You sign in with your Maru account and approve the connection. Generation asks for its own permission and counts toward your account's monthly allowance.
defaultPrompt: Which official Maru synths could do a squelchy acid bass? List the cutoff and resonance ranges.
Find a community chorus I could start from and show me how it modulates its delay.
Show me the effect templates and start a tape delay project called Night Tape.
